name: Independent on Sunday cryptic crossword No 1,511

clue.text: Get rid of officer during cut in firm with restrictive hiring policy

indicators.note: something happening during an event sits within it, so these pieces go inside the cut

blocks.note: to lose something is to get rid of it
DS is a Detective Sergeant, a police officer
a chop is a cut

explanation.surface: A manager sacks an officer while slashing costs at a company that is fussy about whom it hires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get rid of' looks like the definition of a sacking, but it supplies a plain verb; 'during cut' puts the pair inside the chop.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed shop is a workplace where only members of a particular trade union may be employed.

clue.text: Killer of topless girls getting home

indicators.note: without a top means each word loses its opening letter

blocks.note: two girls, each a lass
being in means being at home

explanation.surface: A sensational headline about a murderer of topless girls who has gone home.
explanation.walkthrough: The plural 'girls' supplies two lasses, each losing its L: ASS + ASS + IN.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a murderer, specifically one who kills a prominent person for political reasons or for pay.

clue.text: Rough old soldier hiding in farm building

indicators.note: something hiding in a place is concealed within it, so those letters go inside

blocks.note: O is a standard abbreviation for old
RM is a Royal Marine
a sty is where pigs are kept

explanation.surface: A grizzled old soldier lies low in a pigsty.
explanation.walkthrough: A Royal Marine is a common crossword soldier, alongside GI and OR.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough seas or rough weather are stormy, wild and turbulent conditions.

clue.text: Partners attending opening of observatory with cocaine

indicators.note: the opening of a word is its first letter, so only that one is kept

blocks.note: North and South are partners at the bridge table
first letter of observatory
W is an abbreviation for with

explanation.surface: A couple turn up at the launch of an observatory with drugs in tow.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, South and North play as a pair, hence SN for partners.
explanation.definitionFit: Snow is street slang for powdered cocaine, from its white crystalline look.

clue.text: Tool encasing buddhist monk's portable stove

indicators.note: to encase something is to wrap it up inside, so one word goes around the other

blocks.note: a sander is a power tool for smoothing wood
a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist monk

explanation.surface: A tool somehow belongs to a Buddhist monk, who carries a little stove.
explanation.walkthrough: LAMA goes inside SANDER: SA(LAMA)NDER; the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides the lizard, a salamander is a small portable heater or stove used for drying or warming.

clue.text: Space in M&S used by women getting attention for some of its clothing

indicators.note: in places one item inside the other, here inside the store's initials

blocks.note: an en is a printer's space, half an em
the letters of Marks & Spencer's initials
W is an abbreviation for women
to have someone's ear is to have their attention

explanation.surface: Floor space at Marks & Spencer taken over by women drawing attention to its clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: M&S is Marks & Spencer, a British high-street store. 'Its' points back to the store, so the definition only makes sense through the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Menswear is the men's clothing department, which is one part of the range a big store like that sells.

clue.text: Passion in letter unyielding

blocks.note: the name of the letter R, spelt out
dour means stern and obstinate

explanation.surface: A passionate letter whose writer will not give an inch.
explanation.walkthrough: Letters can be clued by their spelt names: R is 'ar'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardour is intense enthusiasm or fervent love, so it is a synonym for strong feeling.

clue.text: Insensitive wife finally accepted by relative

indicators.note: finally points to the end of a word, so only its closing letter is kept
being accepted by something means being taken inside it

blocks.note: last letter of wife
a dad is a family relative

explanation.surface: An unfeeling wife is eventually welcomed into the family by a relative.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead limb or nerve is numb and has no feeling, so it lacks sensation entirely.

clue.text: City outside Tunisia turned into part of the Roman Empire

indicators.note: something outside another wraps around it, so these letters surround the rest
turned suggests being twisted about, so the country's letters get rearranged

blocks.note: LA is Los Angeles
taken as written

explanation.surface: A city outside Tunisia became a province of ancient Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Lusitania was the Roman province covering most of modern Portugal and part of western Spain.

clue.text: Inaccessible spot where setter's entertained by Jane?

indicators.note: a guest entertained by a host is taken in, so this letter goes inside the surname

blocks.note: the setter refers to themselves as I
Jane Eyre, the Charlotte Brontë heroine

explanation.surface: The setter hides away somewhere remote as a guest of a woman called Jane.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags Jane as standing for a particular Jane, the Brontë heroine.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyrie is an eagle's nest built high on a cliff, and by extension any lofty remote retreat.

clue.text: Missile trailing special bird

indicators.note: trailing means coming behind, so the weapon's letters follow the other piece

blocks.note: SP is an abbreviation for special
an arrow is a missile shot from a bow

explanation.surface: A missile follows close behind a special bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The sparrow is a small brown songbird very common in gardens and towns.

clue.text: Sailors pretend to bear north then do a runner

indicators.note: to bear something is to carry it, so the hoax word holds the compass letter

blocks.note: ABs are able seamen
to cod is to hoax or kid
N is the abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Sailors fake heading north, then make a getaway.
explanation.walkthrough: Cod is old slang for hoaxing. 'Do a runner' is British slang for fleeing without paying.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to leave hurriedly and secretly, typically to escape arrest or avoid paying.

clue.text: Dutch pigpen's not cleaned thoroughly

blocks.note: Du. is the dictionary abbreviation for Dutch
a sty is a pigpen

explanation.surface: A Dutch farmer's pigsty has not been mucked out properly.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left dusty has a layer of grime on it because nobody has wiped it down properly.

clue.text: Animal crossing ploughed up acre in credit with fixture in field ...

indicators.note: one thing crossing another straddles it, so the creature's letters go around the rest
ploughed-up ground is churned over, so these letters are turned into a new order

blocks.note: a sow is a female pig
taken as written
CR is the abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: A beast tramps across a freshly ploughed acre on a farm in the black, leading on to the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram takes in the credit abbreviation as well as acre. The ellipsis just carries the farm scene into 16.
explanation.definitionFit: A scarecrow is a figure dressed in old clothes set up permanently among crops to frighten birds away.

clue.text: Vehicles turned up with mostly fake electronic device

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means read from bottom to top, so the letters run backwards
mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

blocks.note: trams are vehicles running on rails
phoney means fake

explanation.surface: Cars show up loaded with counterfeit gadgets.
explanation.definitionFit: A smartphone is a mobile phone with computing features, a handheld gadget with a touchscreen.

clue.text: Daily news broadcast about Tinseltown's foremost film producer

indicators.note: broadcast suggests something scattered widely, so the newspaper's letters are thrown into a new order
about means around, so the rearranged letters surround the remaining one
foremost means at the very front, so only the first letter of the place is used

blocks.note: taken as written
first letter of Tinseltown

explanation.surface: The day's news bulletin covers Hollywood's leading film-maker.
explanation.walkthrough: Tinseltown is a nickname for Hollywood; its first letter goes inside the shuffled newspaper words.
explanation.definitionFit: Walt Disney founded the animation studio behind Mickey Mouse and produced many famous films.

clue.text: ... has learnt legend about children abandoned in forest

indicators.note: about suggests moving around, so the letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Continuing from 14: the scarecrow has picked up a folk tale about children left in the woods.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Grimm fairy tale, a brother and sister are deserted in the woods and find a witch's gingerbread house.

clue.text: Choice made by evangelical leader reading in church

indicators.note: the leader is whatever comes first, so only the opening letter is kept

blocks.note: first letter of evangelical
a lection is a passage of scripture read in a service

explanation.surface: An evangelical leader picks the Bible passage for a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: An election is the act of choosing, so in an older or theological sense it simply means a selection.

clue.text: Tense Australian male entering troubled Asian island state

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so these letters are put within the other word
something troubled is disturbed, so its letters are thrown into disorder

blocks.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
A is an abbreviation for Australian
M is an abbreviation for male
taken as written

explanation.surface: A nervous Australian man ends up on a troubled Asian island.
explanation.walkthrough: A and M go into ASIAN, the whole mixed up, with T in front.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasmania is an island off the south-east coast of mainland Australia and one of its six states.

clue.text: Publicity surrounding liquid used for washing material found in fabrics

indicators.note: surrounding means going all round, so the publicity word wraps around the other

blocks.note: a poster is a piece of publicity
lye is an alkaline solution used for washing and soap-making

explanation.surface: An advert promoting washing liquid shows off the stuff clothes are made from.
explanation.definitionFit: Polyester is a synthetic polymer widely woven into clothing and other textiles.

clue.text: Health professional protecting lower part of airway in soft part of neck

indicators.note: in a down entry the lower part of a word is its bottom letter, the last one
protecting something means shielding it on both sides, so these letters go around it
in places this group inside the word for soft

blocks.note: RN is a Registered Nurse
last letter of airway
lax means slack or soft

explanation.surface: A nurse shields the lower airway in the soft part of the throat.
explanation.walkthrough: The anatomical surface makes 'lower part of airway' look like the definition; it only supplies one letter, and the nested containers do the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: The larynx, or voice box, is the organ in the front of the throat housing the vocal cords.

clue.text: Located wings of albatross in part of garden

indicators.note: the wings of a word are its two edges, so only its first and last letters are kept
in places those letters inside the garden word

blocks.note: first and last letters of albatross
a flower bed is part of a garden

explanation.surface: An albatross's wings turn up in a flowerbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something based somewhere is situated or stationed there, as a company is based in a city.

clue.text: Small soldier has trimmed ribbon on cap

indicators.note: trimmed means cut short, so the word loses its last letter
in a down entry, on means placed above, so this piece comes first

blocks.note: a band is a strip of ribbon
a tam, or tam-o'-shanter, is a Scottish woollen cap

explanation.surface: A short soldier has a cut-down ribbon on his cap.
explanation.definitionFit: Bantams were First World War soldiers below the usual minimum height, serving in special battalions.

clue.text: Special cart distributed church's cash

indicators.note: distributed means spread around, so these letters are shuffled

blocks.note: S is an abbreviation for special
taken as written
CH is an abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: A special cart hands out the church's collection money.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Scratch is informal slang for money, as in earning a bit of scratch.

clue.text: Deposit is returned to lieutenant

indicators.note: returned means sent back the way it came, so the short word is read backwards

blocks.note: taken as written
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: A security deposit is handed back to a lieutenant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deposit' reads as money handed over, but here it is sediment.
explanation.definitionFit: Silt is fine sand or clay that water carries along and lays down as sediment.

clue.text: Vans breaking down in shed curtailed campaign

indicators.note: something breaking down falls apart, so these letters come out in a new order
curtailed means cut short, so the last letter is dropped
in places the shuffled letters inside the shortened word

blocks.note: taken as written
to cast is to shed, as a snake does its skin

explanation.surface: Vans broken down inside a shed bring a campaign to a premature end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shed' looks like a garden building, but it is the verb: CAST, cut to CAS.
explanation.definitionFit: To canvass is to go door to door seeking votes or support, which is what campaigning involves.

clue.text: Bird in small pile of hay

blocks.note: first meaning: a male fowl
second meaning: a conical heap of hay in a field

explanation.surface: A bird nestles in a little haystack.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a rooster and a small cone-shaped stack of hay, as in haycock.

clue.text: Language used in Berlin government

indicators.note: used in says the letters are found inside the following words

blocks.note: the letters run across the two words

explanation.surface: The jargon used by the German government in Berlin.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingo is an informal word for a foreign tongue or for specialist jargon.

clue.text: 9 accepting new crate of fruit

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the number holds the other letters
new signals the letters are made into something fresh, a different order

blocks.note: the number read as a word, not a cross-reference
taken as written

explanation.surface: A grocer's crate of fruit, apparently delivered by clue 9.
explanation.walkthrough: '9' looks like a pointer to 9 across; it is just the word NINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A nectarine is a smooth-skinned variety of peach, a juicy stone fruit.
